description: Control catalogue v1 for automated compliance checking (ISO27001 Annex A + PDPA 2010).

controls.title: Disable SSH root login
controls.recommendation: Set PermitRootLogin no in /etc/ssh/sshd_config and restart sshd.
controls.iso_mapping: ISO27001 Annex A (Access Control / Identity & Access)
controls.pdpa_mapping: Security principle: protect personal data via strong access control.

controls.title: Disable SSH password authentication
controls.recommendation: Set PasswordAuthentication no in /etc/ssh/sshd_config. Use key-based authentication.
controls.pdpa_mapping: Security principle: reduce credential compromise risk.

controls.title: System logging service is running
controls.recommendation: Enable and start rsyslog (or journald forwarding). Ensure logs are generated and retained.
controls.pdpa_mapping: Security principle: maintain audit trails to detect incidents affecting personal data.

controls.title: Authentication log file exists
controls.recommendation: Ensure /var/log/auth.log exists and is readable. Confirm SSH login events are recorded.
controls.pdpa_mapping: Security principle: keep access logs for accountability.

controls.title: Firewall is enabled (UFW)
controls.recommendation: Enable UFW and allow only required ports. Example: ufw enable; ufw allow 22/tcp.
controls.iso_mapping: ISO27001 Annex A (Network Security / Configuration Management)
controls.pdpa_mapping: Security principle: prevent unauthorized access to systems processing personal data.

controls.title: No weak SSH ciphers enabled
controls.recommendation: Remove CBC/legacy ciphers from sshd_config. Use modern ciphers like chacha20-poly1305 or aes-gcm.
controls.pdpa_mapping: Security principle: ensure strong encryption for data protection.

controls.title: Minimum TLS version is 1.2
controls.recommendation: Disable TLS 1.0/1.1 and weak cipher suites. Enforce TLS 1.2+ on services.
controls.pdpa_mapping: Security principle: protect data-in-transit with strong TLS.

controls.title: Minimum password length is 8 or more
controls.recommendation: Set minimum password length to 8+ via Local Security Policy or domain policy.
controls.pdpa_mapping: Security principle: reduce account compromise risk.

controls.title: Password complexity is enabled
controls.recommendation: Enable password complexity requirements in policy settings.
controls.pdpa_mapping: Security principle: strengthen authentication to protect personal data.

controls.title: Windows Event Log service is running
controls.recommendation: Start the Windows Event Log service and ensure security events (4624/4625) are recorded.
controls.pdpa_mapping: Security principle: maintain audit trails for accountability.

controls.title: Windows Firewall is enabled
controls.recommendation: Enable Windows Firewall for Domain/Private/Public profiles and allow only required inbound ports.
controls.pdpa_mapping: Security principle: reduce attack surface for systems handling personal data.

controls.title: Real-time antivirus protection is enabled
controls.recommendation: Enable Microsoft Defender real-time protection and ensure signatures are up to date.
controls.pdpa_mapping: Security principle: prevent malware incidents that could expose personal data.
